content.title: Oscars 2026 recap: See all the winners and best moments
content.text: OscarsLast updated: Monday, March 16, 2026 10:04AM GMT"One Battle After Another" has won the Best Picture Oscar at the 2026 Academy Awards.LOS ANGELES -- At the 2026 Oscars, the biggest and brightest stars from across Hollywood and the world of entertainment converged in Los Angeles to honor the most prestigious works of filmmaking delivered over the last year.Scroll below to see how the night unfolded, and check out all coverage of the 98th Academy Awards here.Mar 15, 2026, 7:39 PM GMTWho won at last year's Oscars?"Anora" was the top winner at the 2025 Oscars, taking home five awards, including best director for Sean Baker.Other major wins included Adrien Brody for best actor in "The Brutalist" and Mikey Madison for best actress in "Anora." Kieran Culkin won for best supporting actor for "A Real Pain," while Zoe Saldaña won best supporting actress for "Emilia Pérez."Relive some of the biggest moments here.This split image shows Zoe Saldaña, left, Cynthia Erivo, middle, and Sean Baker, right at the Oscars on Sunday, March 2, 2025, at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles.Mar 15, 2026, 7:14 PM GMTA look at the Oscar nominationsHollywood's biggest night is almost here and we have a look at the nominations for the 2026 Oscars.Each of the 24 categories has five nominees, except for best picture, which has 10. This year's ceremony also includes a new category: casting.Take a look at the full list here.On The Red Carpet is breaking down this year's Oscar races in a special featuring new interviews with some of Hollywood's biggest stars.Mar 15, 2026, 7:08 PM GMTOscars host Conan O'Brien on how he's keeping it fresh and funnyConan O'Brien, who's hosting the 2026 Oscars for the second year, opened up about returning to the helm for the second year in a row and what he has planned for the ceremony."I'm chill, because we've been working really hard. We have a lot of fun ideas," O'Brien told ABC News' Lara Spencer in an interview that aired Thursday on "Good Morning America.""It doesn't mean a million things won't go wrong or sideways between now and the actual show, but that can be a challenge too," he continued, adding that it's "always a running battle up until the moment the Oscars begins."See the full story and interview here.Joelle Garguilo sat down with Oscars host Conan O'Brien.Mar 15, 2026, 6:40 PM GMTHow and where to watch the OscarsYou won't want to miss the 2026 Oscars, and all the post-show excitement!The 98th Academy Awards will air live on ABC in more than 200 territories worldwide beginning at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT.You can watch the ceremony for free over-the-air on your local ABC station. It will also be available to stream on Hulu.Go here for a look at how to watch our pre-show with all the red carpet arrivals, and get everything to know about the 98th Academy Awards.
